### Explore How Fortrea Can Support Your Cardiovascular Development Program


Beyond traditional clinical trial execution, Fortrea's Medical Device & Diagnostics team supports sponsors with development strategy, regulatory pathway planning, risk-based study design, evidence generation, clinical evaluation support, and post-market evidence programs. Our experience spans Class II and Class III cardiovascular technologies, implantable devices, diagnostics, connected health solutions, and software-enabled medical technologies, helping sponsors efficiently progress from concept to commercialization.


## Supporting a Range of Cardiovascular Technologies


Fortrea supports development programs across multiple[cardiovascular therapy areas](https://www.fortrea.com/therapeutics/cardiovascular) , including:


- Structural Heart


Fortrea supports structural heart programs that use transcatheter and surgical approaches to treat valve disease and other structural conditions. Our experience covers aortic, mitral and tricuspid valve repair and replacement, surgical heart valves, annuloplasty systems and left atrial appendage closure devices. We support the full lifecycle, from early feasibility and first-in-human studies through pivotal, post-approval and registry studies. That includes selecting experienced implanting centres and coordinating imaging and long-term follow-up.


- Coronary and Peripheral Vascular Disease


Our teams support interventions that restore blood flow and treat vascular disorders. Indications include coronary artery disease, acute coronary syndrome, peripheral artery disease, and abdominal and thoracic aortic aneurysms. Device types include coronary and peripheral drug-eluting stents, drug-coated balloons, endovascular and thoracic aortic stent grafts, venous stents and thrombectomy systems. We also support studies that need long-term follow-up across multiple countries.


- Cardiac Rhythm Management


Fortrea supports the clinical development of pacing, defibrillation, electrophysiology and rhythm-monitoring technologies. Our experience includes permanent and leadless pacemakers, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), cardiac resynchronisation therapy (CRT) devices, ablation catheters and implantable loop recorders. Atrial fibrillation is one of the top indications in our cardiovascular device portfolio.


- Cardiovascular Diagnostics


We support evidence generation for cardiovascular diagnostic devices, IVDs and biomarker-based technologies, as well as imaging solutions. Our support spans clinical performance studies and regulatory pathways under FDA, EU MDR/IVDR and UK requirements. Integrated data management, biostatistics and quality oversight help produce robust evidence for regulatory, reimbursement and commercial decisions.


- Digital Cardiovascular Health


Fortrea has experience with connected technologies, wearable devices, software-enabled medical technologies and remote patient monitoring, including heart failure monitoring technologies. We help sponsors design studies that capture continuous, real-world data and handle the data integrity and usability needs specific to digital health.


## Our Medical Device & Diagnostics team has successfully supported sponsors developing:


- Transcatheter aortic, mitral and tricuspid valve technologies
- Coronary, peripheral vascular and venous intervention devices
- Leadless pacemakers, ICDs, CRT systems and electrophysiology platforms
- Heart failure monitoring and mechanical circulatory support technologies
- Cardiovascular diagnostic and biomarker-based testing solutions
- Connected health, wearable monitoring and AI-enabled cardiovascular technologies
- Post-market registries and long-term follow-up programs supporting global regulatory and commercial objectives


From first-in-human investigations to global pivotal studies and post-market evidence programs, Fortrea provides integrated clinical, regulatory, operational and scientific experience to help sponsors advance innovative cardiovascular technologies from concept to commercialization


## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)


- What types of cardiovascular devices and diagnostics does Fortrea support?


Fortrea supports a broad range of cardiovascular technologies, including structural heart, interventional cardiology, cardiac rhythm management, vascular intervention, heart failure and cardiovascular diagnostics.


- Can Fortrea support global cardiovascular studies?


Yes. Fortrea conducts cardiovascular studies across established and emerging markets, supporting site selection, study execution and patient recruitment worldwide.


- Does Fortrea support early feasibility and first-in-human studies?


Yes. Fortrea supports cardiovascular development from early feasibility and first-in-human studies through pivotal trials, post-approval studies, registries and post-market research.


- What services does Fortrea provide for cardiovascular studies?


Fortrea offers clinical operations, project management, medical monitoring, regulatory support, data management, biostatistics, safety, patient recruitment and quality oversight throughout the study lifecycle.


- Can Fortrea support post-market cardiovascular studies?


Yes. Fortrea supports post-market clinical follow-up (PMCF), post-market performance follow-up (PMPF), registries, long-term follow-up studies, performance evaluation studies, and real-world evidence (RWE) programmes.


- Why work with a CRO for cardiovascular device studies?


A CRO can provide global study delivery, regulatory support and operational capabilities across feasibility, pivotal and post-market studies.

## Meet the team


Cheerag Shirodaria, MD


Vice President, Therapeutic Strategy Leader


Cheerag Shirodaria, MD


Vice President, Therapeutic Strategy Leader


**Dr. Cheerag Shirodaria** is the Vice President and Cardiovascular/Metabolic Therapeutic Area Head at Fortrea. He has over 25 years of clinical experience as an interventional and clinical cardiologist and remains on the Faculty at Oxford University Hospitals. He is an expert in cardiac imaging, having completed his doctoral thesis at the University of Oxford on the role of cardiovascular MRI in the evaluation of vascular function. He is also co-director of the coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) service in Oxford. He is also co-founder and Chief Development Officer of Caristo Diagnostics, an AI image analysis company that has developed proprietary AI image analysis technology that quantifies cardiometabolic risk associated with coronary inflammation plaque and adipose tissue characteristics. He has supported multiple companies through regulatory interactions, protocol development and Scientific Advisory Board interactions.


Dr. Shirodaria received his medical degree from St. Bartholomew’s Hospital Medical College in London, his medical doctorate from the University of Oxford and his MBA from London Business School.
